Messages.Author: George Tran
Messages.Body:
Silly question.

Is it possible to heal minions such as Talaq and Order of Cabal? Can
you send them off to "hunt" to get life back??

Cheers
George

Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:


Never a sily question, George. :)

In general, allies cannot hunt. Once they lose life, it cannot be regained unless
the card says so.

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 29 Jul 1996, George Tran wrote:

> Silly question.

Not really...

> Is it possible to heal minions such as Talaq and Order of Cabal? Can
> you send them off to "hunt" to get life back??

Nope. Their life loss is permanent, barring abilities like Talaq's and
the Mummies ability to gain life, Hell Hound and Garou regeneration, any
future cards with similar powers, or any (as-of-yet-unprinted) cards that
recover allies life.

On a side note, retainers hurt outside of combat have the same problem...

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Russe...@mindlink.bc.ca (DeathWish) writes:
>Does that mean allies are burnt once they reach 0 blood (er...life?) or
>only after they reach negative blood? If they can't hunt, what do they do
>at 0 blood >in the minion phase?

They are burned (same thing for Retainers who reach zero life).

This is explicit, albeit hard to find, in the VtES rulebook:
8.1.1: "An ally who loses all of his life counters is burned."

But contradicted in the same rulebook:
20.1: "Unlike vampires and allies, retainers do not have blood points"

Trust me: 8.1.1 is the correct passage, not 20.1
Allies and retainers have life points, not blood points.
Lose all your life, and you're burned.
